title: Simple Enchants
body: This pack adds some useful enchantments. Name | Type | Effect | Max Level | Applies to | Incompatable with ---- | ---- | ------ | --------- | ---------- | ----------------- Absorbant | Normal | Increases maximum absorbtion hearts. 1 heart per level. | 6 (VI) | Chest Armour/Elytra Vitality | Normal | Increases maximum health. +1 heart per level. | 5 (V) | Chest Armour/Elytra Antigravity | Normal | Decreases gravity. -1 per level. | 10 (X) | Boots Weight | Curse | Increases gravity. 1 per level. | 10 (X) | Boots Reach | Normal | Increases reach distance. +1 per level. | 5 (V) | Anything with durability Venomous | Normal | Applies poison to the target. +1 per level. | 2 (II) | Sword/Axe | Fire Aspect Enlargement | Normal | Increases the user's size, speed, health, max absorbtion, and jump height. +1% per level. | 10 (X) | Chest Armour/Elytra Shrinking | Normal | Decreases the user's size, speed, health, max absorbtion, and jump height. -1% per level. | 10 (X) | Chest Armour/Elytra
